name: WDZD Swap
rootCause: The DeFi protocol WDZD Swap on BSC was exploited and lost about $1.1 million. The attackers made nine malicious transactions that drained 609 Binance-Pegged ETH from contracts related to the WDZD project.

descriptions.text: The DeFi protocol WDZD Swap on BSC was exploited and lost about $1.1 million. The attackers made nine malicious transactions that drained 609 Binance-Pegged ETH from contracts related to the WDZD project.

WDZD Swap was exploited on BNB Chain on 2023-05-19. Public reporting attributes the loss to a flaw in an unverified Swap LP contract that allowed an attacker to manipulate LP token acquisition and drain roughly 609 Binance-Pegged ETH, valued at about $1.1 million at the time. Public reporting and CertiK statements describe a swap and LP accounting flaw in an unverified WDZD Swap LP/factory contract on BNB Chain. The attacker reportedly triggered an unverified low-level function call that transferred WDZD tokens from the pair to the factory address, allowing the attacker to obtain disproportionate LP tokens and redeem them for underlying ETH. On May 19, an attacker successfully exploited the BNB Chain-based defi project WDZD Swap, making off with 609 Binance-Pegged ETH (~$1.1 million). The attack was apparently executed by a known exploiter, who had also previously exploited a project called Swap X.
